name: dptb-pilot
description: Use a remote DPTB Pilot agent directly from Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Call a configured DPTB Pilot server from Codex.
interface.longDescription: DPTB Pilot connects Codex to an existing DPTB Pilot FastAPI backend using a configured server URL and session id. It exposes chat, health checks, and session file operations as MCP tools.
